guard: only the exact Jcode Harness invalid_request capability refusal is classified as unsupported; copied text, another code, and near-miss wording stay generic

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification accepts copied untrusted Error text
mutations.expectRed: a plain Error with copied capability text stays a generic refusal

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification ignores the stable invalid_request code
mutations.expectRed: a different Harness code with copied capability text stays a generic refusal

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification accepts any unsupported-reasoning invalid_request
mutations.find: /^invalid_request: Reasoning effort is not supported by the current model\/profile\./.test(error.message)
mutations.expectRed: a near-miss invalid_request message stays a generic refusal
